actions.exact_inputs: target identity; exact version; adoption decision; approved package-set digest; snapshot digest
actions.failure_and_readback: read health and exact identity; intentional candidate checksum failure; prove original instance unchanged
actions.negative_permission: candidate namespace conflict or unknown instance stops before mutation
actions.no_op: same healthy identity/version; adopt never runs an empty-host installer
actions.rollback: first-install restore uninstalled candidate only; adopt retain existing instance and restore verified snapshot only under separate restore approval

actions.exact_inputs: target repository identity; full source SHA; independently approved refs/bundle digest; trust approval
actions.failure_and_readback: import exact refs to staging; read full source SHA; fail wrong source and leave main unchanged
actions.negative_permission: project writer cannot create cross-project objects or push/force main
actions.no_op: matching repository/source is read only; foreign repository is BLOCKED
actions.rollback: never delete an adopted repository; preserve imported refs/evidence; new candidate deletion requires separate destructive approval

actions.exact_inputs: exact repository; protected main; empty direct/force allowlists; company human merge identity reference
actions.failure_and_readback: negative push/force/merge probes on isolated disposable repo; readback protection after deliberate denied request
actions.negative_permission: project agent, manager, provider, shared bot cannot merge or direct/force push main
actions.no_op: canonical protection readback equal; no rewrite
actions.rollback: restore only pinned protection snapshot without broadening access; if prior state unsafe stop for human review

actions.exact_inputs: exact repository; nonempty canonical contexts; same expected source head
actions.failure_and_readback: deliberate failed check blocks PR; repair via normal PR; bind successful contexts to exact final head
actions.negative_permission: missing or failed context cannot authorize merge
actions.rollback: retain protection; previous contexts only after readback proves no weaker gate

actions.exact_inputs: exact scm-ci identity; runner binary/config digest; platform-only scope; independent registration authorization
actions.failure_and_readback: job fails intentionally then successful isolated verification; read scope and digest; no timer enabled
actions.negative_permission: no production credentials, no appserver runtime, no cross-project privilege
actions.rollback: disable only newly authorized runner activation; preserve registration evidence; secrets managed separately

actions.exact_inputs: exact source SHA/ref digest; allowlisted source transport; exact destination staging ref; independent site approval
actions.failure_and_readback: bad input SHA fails before fetch/import; verify staging/source equality; manual approval PR and required CI remain separate
actions.negative_permission: inbound cannot force/direct push main or merge; no copied Issues/accounts/PATs
actions.no_op: same staging SHA no-op; protected main never changes
actions.rollback: retain inbound ref audit; halt further one-shot attempts; never reset main or enable timer

actions.exact_inputs: approved local platform change; original source SHA; company approval PR and human merge SHA; required contexts
actions.failure_and_readback: one failed CI and recovery; human merge; preserve source and company merge SHA mapping plus artifact digest
actions.negative_permission: prove direct/force push and unauthorized merge denied
actions.no_op: replay identical evidence is validation only; every new canary needs fresh evidence
actions.rollback: revert via protected human PR; preserve provenance and original immutable bytes; no automated merge/reset
